secrets.name: CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY
secrets.description: Master encryption key for the server-side credential vault (AES-256-GCM). Generate with: openssl rand -base64 32. Without this, stored credentials use an ephemeral key and will NOT survive a restart. Set once and keep stable.

secrets.name: GITHUB_TOKEN
secrets.description: GitHub Personal Access Token with repo access — used to inspect repositories and commit changes. Can also be stored in the vault via the CredentialsPopover UI.

secrets.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
secrets.description: OpenAI API key — optional, can be stored in the vault via the CredentialsPopover UI.
